objective: Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.

description: Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, <name>, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
progress: Your task is not yet complete, <name>. Return to me once 7 mangy nightsabers and 7 thistle boars have been killed.
completion: You have proven your dedication to nature well, <name>. A young <class> like yourself has a promising future.
